The files below this directory are unmodified copies from the Docutils 0.23
source distribution (https://docutils.sourceforge.io/): the documentation
(docs/), the top-level project documents and the inputs of the functional
tests (test/functional/input/).  They are used as test inputs only; see the
individual files and COPYING.rst for their terms (public domain unless noted
otherwise).

test/functional/input/dangerous.rst is intentionally not included: it reads
/etc/passwd, which would end up in the expected output.

Expected output: ../docutils.expected (generated by scripts/regen.sh).
